messages:
anna: Quick async triage for this quarter's milestone rollups — posting ship/slip/next actions per item. Reply with owner/ETA or +1 if good.

anna: Milestone A (model-routing v1): shipped to staging, latency SLOs met in perf tests. Prod canary blocked by capacity tagging. Owner: @kevin. Next: finalize capacity tag mapping, request Dedicated pool.

kevin: Confirmed owner. Filing pool request today. ETA for request approval 48h from now.

priya: Milestone B (console rollouts — rollout flags + UX): slipped — design review took longer, devs hit CR backlog. Owner: @priya. Next: small scope cut to deliver flags-only by EOW.

mike: Re: CR backlog — I can pair on the remaining 2 PRs tomorrow. ping me which ones.

priya: Thanks @mike — will DM PR links.

anna: Milestone C (cache/kv autosave): partial ship (read cache live), write path delayed due to test flakiness. Blocker: flaky integration test that fails under GPU load. Suspect race in KV flush.

kevin: Can reproduce locally with stress tool. Here's the failing step: ```bash
./stress-kv --concurrency 32 --seq-len 512
# fails at flush-to-disk step after ~30m
```

sophie: I can pick up test mitigation & add a deterministic seed to reduce flakiness. Will open a WIP PR today.

anna: Ownership clarifications: for infra capacity -> @kevin, console UX -> @priya, cache reliability -> @sophie (with @mike helping on CRs). If anyone disagrees, call it out.

kevin: FYI capacity request might need billing sign-off for burst buffers. CC @finance later if approved.

mike: Ack. If billing holds us up, can we soft-fallback to hosted pool temporarily?

anna: Yes — plan B is to route canary traffic to hosted pool for next 24–72h while Dedicated is approved. We'll track cost impact.

deploy-bot: Note: canary deploy scheduled for 2026-04-05T22:00Z pending capacity and final smoke tests.

priya: Quick ask — product needs a one-liner for PM update: "What shipped vs slipped". Draft: "Shipped: model-routing v1 to staging; Console flags pushed to dev; Read-cache live. Slipped: console UX rollout and cache write-path; blocked by design & flaky tests. Actions: capacity request, CR pairing, deterministic test fixes." Thoughts?

mike: Draft looks good. Add owner names and ETAs if possible.

anna: Updated draft with owners & ETAs: will send to PMs after @kevin confirms capacity ETA and @sophie confirms PR timeline.

kevin: Capacity approval ETA = ~48h.

sophie: PR WIP — aiming EOD tomorrow for tests + patch.

anna: Great. If no objections I'll mark this thread as the canonical async update and ping execs tomorrow AM with the one-liner + owners/ETAs. :thumbsup:

kevin: +1

priya: +1

mike: +1

sophie: +1

deploy-bot: Thread archived to project-qtr-milestones after 72h of inactivity.
